mapper.sql: select r.id, r.class_id, r.group_id, r.level, r.content, r.progress, r.send_time, r.resolved, g.group_name, c.class_name, (select t.task_name from te_task_assign a left join te_task t on t.id = a.task_id where a.group_id = r.group_id order by a.id limit 1) as task_name from te_warning_record r left join te_group g on g.id = r.group_id left join te_class c on c.id = r.class_id
mapper.select: where r.group_id = #{groupId} and r.level = #{level} and r.resolved = 0 limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into te_warning_record (class_id, group_id, level, content, progress, send_time, resolved) values (#{classId}, #{groupId}, #{level}, #{content}, #{progress}, #{sendTime}, 0)
mapper.select: where r.class_id = #{classId} order by r.resolved asc, r.level desc, r.send_time desc
where r.group_id = #{groupId} and r.resolved = 0 order by r.send_time desc
mapper.update: update te_warning_record set resolved = 1 where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select level as `level`, count(1) as `cnt` from te_warning_record where class_id = #{classId} and resolved = 0 group by level
select count(1) from te_warning_record where group_id = #{groupId} and resolved = 0
